subject: Shipping to Canada?
body:
Bonjour,

We run a small crèmerie in Montréal. Do you ship custom cups to Canada? We would want about 30,000 12oz cups with our logo. Please send a price that includes shipping and duties.

Merci,
Étienne Gagnon
Crèmerie Boréale
needs_human_reason: Shipping to Canada, outside the lower 48 (rule 4): there's no standard freight rate, and duties aren't covered by the KB (rule 7).
summary: Montréal crèmerie wants 30k 12 oz custom cups with a price including shipping and duties. Cups $3,450-$3,600 (1-2 colors) via USA partner; the owner must quote freight and duties. Reply in French.
draft_reply:
Bonjour Étienne,

Oui, nous pouvons imprimer vos gobelets, mais nous n'avons pas de tarif standard pour l'expédition au Canada. Notre propriétaire vous contactera directement avec le prix du transport et des droits de douane.

Voici le prix des gobelets pour 30 000 gobelets de 12 oz, imprimés par notre partenaire aux États-Unis (impression flexographique, correspondance Pantone possible) :

30 000 x 0,11 $ = 3 300,00 $
Frais de clichés : 150 $ par couleur
Sous-total : 3 450,00 $ (logo 1 couleur) ou 3 600,00 $ (logo 2 couleurs)
Transport et droits : à confirmer par notre propriétaire

Délai : 3 à 4 semaines après l'approbation de l'épreuve numérique, plus le transport.

Pourriez-vous nous indiquer le nombre de couleurs de votre logo et nous envoyer le fichier vectoriel (AI, EPS, PDF ou SVG), ainsi que votre adresse de livraison complète ? Un acompte de 50 % lance la production et le solde est dû avant l'expédition. Ce devis est une estimation valable 30 jours, taxes non comprises.

Merci,
The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: Logo color count not given, so quoted 1 and 2 colors.
Prices shown in our standard (USD) pricing; the owner should confirm currency for a Canadian customer.
owner_note: Quote freight and duties to Montréal. Cups subtotal is $3,450 (1 color) or $3,600 (2 colors).
quote:
Color count not given, so quoted both:

--- If the logo is 1 color(s) ---
REQUEST: 30,000 x 12 oz custom cups, 1 color

RECOMMENDED: USA partner (flexographic) (30,000 x 12 oz)
  Cups: 30,000 x $0.11 = $3,300.00
  Setup (plates): 1 color(s) x $150.00 = $150.00
  Subtotal: $3,450.00
  Freight: outside the lower 48, no standard rate. The owner will quote freight (and any duties)
  TOTAL: $3,450.00 + freight TBD
  Lead time: 3-4 weeks after proof approval; ships approx Tue Mar 30 - Tue Apr 6 if the proof is approved by Tue Mar 9 (transit time not included)
  Color: Pantone (PMS) matching available.

NOT AVAILABLE AS ASKED:
  In-house digital: In-house digital maximum is 9,999 cups
  Overseas (offset): Overseas (offset) minimum is 50,000 cups

Terms: estimate valid 30 days, excludes sales tax; 50% deposit to start, balance before shipping; digital proof with every order.

--- If the logo is 2 color(s) ---
REQUEST: 30,000 x 12 oz custom cups, 2 colors

RECOMMENDED: USA partner (flexographic) (30,000 x 12 oz)
  Cups: 30,000 x $0.11 = $3,300.00
  Setup (plates): 2 color(s) x $150.00 = $300.00
  Subtotal: $3,600.00
  Freight: outside the lower 48, no standard rate. The owner will quote freight (and any duties)
  TOTAL: $3,600.00 + freight TBD
  Lead time: 3-4 weeks after proof approval; ships approx Tue Mar 30 - Tue Apr 6 if the proof is approved by Tue Mar 9 (transit time not included)
  Color: Pantone (PMS) matching available.

NOT AVAILABLE AS ASKED:
  In-house digital: In-house digital maximum is 9,999 cups
  Overseas (offset): Overseas (offset) minimum is 50,000 cups

Terms: estimate valid 30 days, excludes sales tax; 50% deposit to start, balance before shipping; digital proof with every order.
